headline: Colonials Recover Ground in Stonecradle and Weathered Expanse
war_summary: Since our last edition the tide has turned on the war's twin storm fronts. The Weathered Expanse, which stood six bases Warden to three when we last wrote, now reads five Colonial to four after thirty-four base actions in a day, Crow's Nest and Frostmarch the storm centers, though the fighting there has paused since before dawn. Stonecradle has swung harder still: eleven actions inside two hours, the latest logged at filing time, left the Colonials holding eight bases against one, World's End the busiest point and the day's toll above twenty-six thousand. In Mooring County the Wardens yielded another post, cutting their lead to nine-three, with fresh fighting at Gravekeeper's Holdfast and The Cut and hourly losses on both sides climbing past six hundred. Callahan's Passage has seen no base change, yet its casualty rolls run near five hundred an hour and still rise. Farranac Coast remains unsettled about Transient Valley, and Stlican Shelf, base-silent since the prior morning, bleeds at climbing rates, while the Linn of Mercy has cooled and the Nevish Line and Dead Lands stay calm. It is the 350th day of the war; no victor is declared, and thirty-four victory towns remain the prize.
